page.overview:
Who is Barnabas Tharmr?

Barnabas Tharmr is the secondary antagonist of Final Fantasy XVI. The king of Waloed and the Dominant of Odin, Barnabas brings chaos to Valisthea and seeks to bring Clive Rosfield in contact with other Dominants of the realm for a nefarious purpose that threatens all of mankind.

While much of Barnabas's early life remains a mystery, he was raised in the lands beyond the Southern Seas of Valisthea by his mother who was a follower of the "Circle of Malius", an ancient religion that worships Ultima. Due to the advancement of Blight, at 6 years old Barnabas and his mother fled across the Southern Seas to Ash, where they would be taken in by followers of the same faith. Due to their beliefs being viewed as heresy, Barnabas's mother ended up being killed by members of a rival religion. This event seems to have instilled a great hatred toward humanity within Barnabas and prompted him to eventually unite the warring tribes of Ash under him.

As a descendant of the "Motes of Darkness", a people whose lineage was bound to the Eikon Odin, Barnabas awakened as the Dominant of Darkness when his mother died, forming Sleipnir Harbard as a direct result. With this great power in his hands he established the Kingdom of Waloed by uniting the warring tribes of Ash, with the new capital, Stonhyrr, built upon the nation he had conquered: Veldermarke. He also quelled the beast tribe rebellions, bringing them to heel.

In the year 850, Ultima confronted Barnabas, the very being whom his original people worshipped. Aligning himself with his god's belief that all of humanity's evils stem from free will, Barnabas devoted himself to Ultima and in return was made Akashic while being allowed to maintain sanity and human appearance. Retaining his youth, Barnabas continued ruling his nation for forty years after his conquest of Ash. During his reign, he spread the beliefs and rituals of the savior cult among his people, extolling the virtues of abandoning free will in exchange of becoming a "pure" mindless thrall free of mortal suffering.
